name: Move Pattern
description: The move content ontology design pattern. This CP represents the action of moving a physical object from a place to another. The move CP is extracted from the CIDOC ontology.
competency_questions: Where did a given object start out and where did it end up when it was moved?; Which objects were taken out of a given place, and which ones arrived there?; Which shorter legs make up a longer transfer, and where does each leg begin and end?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
